payload.core_mechanism_summary: Concatenates first string with reverse of second, then checks if there are more than one occurrence of 'RR' or 'BB', or any 'RRR' or 'BBB'; beauty is possible if not.
payload.rationale: The solution is a linear-time greedy check, not a complete search. Forced to pick a search subtype; backtracking is the least unrelated, but the algorithm has no search component.
